mainEntity.name: What is a Global Capability Center?

acceptedAnswer.text: A GCC is an in-country operating center that supports engineering, product, finance, operations, or shared services for a global enterprise.

mainEntity.name: Why should companies build a GCC in India?

acceptedAnswer.text: India offers deep talent pools, strong digital infrastructure, mature startup ecosystems, and proven global delivery capability.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to hire a GCC team?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timelines depend on function, city, seniority, and hiring volume. A hiring plan and recruiter support can help the process stay organized.

mainEntity.name: Which city is best for a GCC?

acceptedAnswer.text: City choice depends on the business goals, talent needs, and hiring volume. EarlyJobs does not rank cities or provide real-estate advice.

mainEntity.name: Can EarlyJobs support greenfield GCC launches?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. EarlyJobs supports greenfield GCC launches from hiring strategy and workforce planning to recruiter deployment and execution.
Recruiter pods are dedicated hiring teams aligned to your functions, geography, and hiring goals, giving you more structure and accountability.

mainEntity.name: Can you support engineering and leadership hiring?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We support both specialist engineering hiring and leadership hiring as part of broader GCC build-out.

mainEntity.name: Do you help with workforce planning?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Workforce planning, hiring roadmap design, and talent mapping are central to our India expansion support.
